evidence: Mount Somers Track runs from the Sharplin Falls car park to the Woolshed Creek car park along the northern side of Mount Somers.
The track is a two-day tramp suitable for families.

evidence: You can also do an overnight return tramp on the track, either from Woolshed Creek car park to Woolshed Creek Hut (an easier option) or from Sharplin Falls car park to Pinnacles Hut (a much more challenging option).

This is an alternative route for the last day of the Mount Somers Track.
From here, the track crosses the face of Mount Somers to link with South Face Track (2 hr from the track start), which then follows a rocky ridge to Woolshed Creek car park.

doubts: Woolshed Creek car park (end of Jig Road) has no road end feature, so its ref is null. F1 is the only Flynns Road road end and Sharplin Falls car park is said to be at the end of Flynns Road. W5: the page describes only the last-day alternative (Woolshed Creek Hut to Woolshed Creek car park, 3 hr / 6.4 km); recorded as the full track with that exit, so its time/distance are left null. The 4WD track and the Sidewinder Track are alternatives for short sections of the last day and are not recorded as ways. The text says the South Face Track 'follows a rocky ridge to Woolshed Creek car park', but the circuit also uses the South Face Track to return to Sharplin Falls car park; recorded as written. Pony Stream is crossed on the way to Pinnacles Hut but its position is not stated, so it is not in via.
